source.value: Rippers Unmasked — The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Essence Sacrifice)

summary.value: You command your Phantasms to replenish your allies' MP.

system.description: You command your Phantasms to replenish your allies' MP. Each Phantasm runs towards a companion and shatters itself in a spray of mana. Each target recovers 20 MP. A single ally cannot be replenished by more than one Phantasm per action.
